As a Staff Software Engineer (iOS) on the Digital Products team, you will provide technical leadership for the architecture, development, and evolution of our iOS platform, helping shape the future of the connected vehicle experience.

You will drive the design and delivery of scalable, high-quality iOS applications and services across key customer-facing products, including vehicle connectivity, mapping and navigation, EV charging experiences, vehicle purchasing journeys, and other strategic digital initiatives.
In this role, you will partner closely with other engineers, product management, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to define and execute the iOS engineering strategy.
You will influence technical direction across multiple teams, establish best practices, and ensure architectural consistency, performance, reliability, and maintainability across the iOS ecosystem.

You will also play a key role in developing engineering talent by mentoring senior and junior engineers, providing technical guidance, fostering collaboration, and elevating the overall effectiveness of the iOS organization.
- Defining and driving the technical vision, architecture, and long-term strategy for our iOS platform and customer-facing mobile experiences.
- 8+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering shipping customer facing applications on iOS.
- Deep expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, and modern iOS development practices, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality mobile experiences.

- Agentic coding tool proficiency Hands-on experience with agentic coding harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex) with specific examples of driving an agent through a non-trivial engineering task, verifying output, and recovering from agent errors

- Claude Code, Kubernetes, AWS, Airflow, dlt, dbt, Python, TypeScript, React, Go
